mutations.name: arm B reuses arm A's sample indices
kills: measureAaFloor runs arm A on samples 0..n-1 and arm B on n..2n-1, and pools σ within each arm

mutations.name: arm B gets a fresh cap
kills: measureAaFloor shares one spend cap over both arms and skips arm B once arm A stopped

mutations.name: the floor section drops the old one's text outside the markers
kills: floor notes writes notes.md and aa-floor.json, and a new floor replaces only the marked section
